units.name: Rotter
units.desc: Miserable shambling corpse. Alone, pitiful. In hundreds, an avalanche.

units.name: Zombie Miner
units.desc: Dead miners who still dig. They tunnel under the front and erupt near your line.
units.counter: Keep militia and blunderbusses near the rear line; Scout Gyros reveal tunnels.

units.name: Shambler
units.desc: Slow, sturdy corpse. Takes a lot of shot to drop.

units.name: Grave Crawler
units.desc: Legless horror that slips beneath the battle line to gnaw on crews and mechanics. Halved blast damage.
units.counter: Riflemen and militia guarding artillery; brass MG fire.

units.name: Plague Runner
units.desc: Bloated sprinter. Bursts in a plague cloud when killed — kill it before it reaches your line.
units.counter: Long-range rifles and cannons; don't let it die in your formation.

units.name: Ossuary Skeleton
units.desc: Rattling bone soldier. Bullets pass through the gaps; blasts and hammers shatter it.

units.name: Rusted Legionary
units.desc: Skeletal legionary in rusted mail and shield.

units.name: Bone Shieldbearer
units.desc: Coffin-lid shield turns aside rifle fire (-70% pierce). Screens archers behind it.

units.name: Bone Pikeman
units.desc: Long pikes strike before swords can reply.

units.name: Ossuary Axeman
units.desc: Cleaving axes that bite into shield walls.

units.name: Grave Knight
units.desc: Armored revenant with a cleaving greatsword. Shrugs off bullets.
units.counter: Armor-piercing cannons, tank shells, Miner Rig.

units.name: Barrow Spearman
units.desc: Hurls barrow-spears from behind the front.

units.name: Blight Marauder
units.desc: Fast raider swinging a blighted cleaver.

units.name: Rotting Berserker
units.desc: Frenzied runner that keeps swinging until it bursts.

units.name: Fungal Host
units.desc: Riddled with fungus; two Rotters burst from it when it falls.

units.name: Pestilent Soldier
units.desc: Plague-soaked soldier; bursts in a toxic cloud.

units.name: Crypt Halberdier
units.desc: Armored skeleton sweeping a long halberd.

units.name: Tomb Stalker
units.desc: Slips under the front line to tear at crews and casters.

units.name: Hollow Guard
units.desc: Black-armored shield bearer that draws fire.

units.name: Risen Bomb Carrier
units.desc: Carries a lit powder keg. Kill it before it reaches you.

units.name: Wretched Climber
units.desc: Scrambles past the front to reach artillery.

units.name: Carcass Devourer
units.desc: Eats as it fights, healing from every bite.

units.name: Bone Vanguard
units.desc: Bone shield and blade at the very front.

units.name: Grave Warden
units.desc: Its lantern hardens nearby undead (-15% damage taken).

units.name: Black Rot Infantry
units.desc: Rot-black soldiers whose blades fester.

units.name: Cursed Dwarf Thrall
units.desc: A fallen dwarf, still holding his rifle. The undead turned our own.

units.name: Plague Mauler
units.desc: Bloated bruiser with fists like barrels.

units.name: Dread Executioner
units.desc: Executioner's axe; picks the toughest target.

units.name: Ossuary Champion
units.desc: Champion of the ossuaries in gilded bone plate.

units.name: Riftbound Legionary
units.desc: Legionary bound to the rift; violet blade ignores some armor.

units.name: Bone Archer
units.desc: Skeletal archer behind the shield wall. Fragile, but picks off riflemen.

units.name: Grave Slinger
units.desc: Slings bone fragments over the front.

units.name: Rot Spitter
units.desc: Swollen corpse that arcs corrosive bile. Acid eats through dwarven armor plate.
units.counter: Kill it before tanks close in — rifles, organ guns, bombers.

units.name: Plague Sprayer
units.desc: Sprays acid in a short cone. Machines hate it.

units.name: Crypt Hexer
units.desc: Hexes slow their victims to a crawl.

units.name: Corpse Priest
units.desc: Mends the dead around it.

units.name: Necromancer
units.desc: Raises fresh Rotters from nearby corpses every few seconds (glowing green telegraph). Bolts hit air and ground.
units.counter: Priority target: cannons, bombers, gunships. Fewer corpses = fewer risen.

units.name: Ossuary Caller
units.desc: Calls skeletons up out of the corpses.

units.name: Cinder Wraith
units.desc: Burning ghost hurling cinders at air and ground.

units.name: Spirit Binder
units.desc: Spirit chains stun what they hit.

units.name: Plague Herald
units.desc: Its horn drives the horde: +20% speed, +15% attack rate nearby.

units.name: Bone Lancer
units.desc: Hurls bone lances that can spear aircraft.

units.name: Grave Dart Thrower
units.desc: Poison darts aimed at crews and support.

units.name: Funeral Bell Keeper
units.desc: Tolls a funeral bell: undead nearby take less damage and strike faster.

units.name: Rot Channeler
units.desc: Channels a rot beam that eats machinery.
units.counter: Keep tanks back; kill it with infantry.

units.name: Ash Hexer
units.desc: Burning hexes that slow and scorch.

units.name: Night Seer
units.desc: Sees far: snipes support units and aircraft.

units.name: Rift Conjurer
units.desc: Opens small rifts that spit out Riftbound Legionaries.
units.counter: Kill it before the rift opens.

units.name: Flesh Hulk
units.desc: Stitched mountain of flesh. Slow, telegraphed ground slams crush whole squads. Bullets sink in.
units.counter: Armor-piercing shells, tanks, Miner Rig; spread infantry when it rears back.

units.name: Bone Golem

stats.weakness: Bone frame: weak to blasts, drills and hammers.

units.desc: Thousands of bones fused around a necrotic core. Bullets rattle through it; hammers and shells break it apart.

units.name: Plague Beast

stats.weakness: Short reach; dies fast to concentrated rifle and cannon fire before it closes.

units.desc: A swollen beast that vomits corrosive bile in a wide cone and leaves boiling plague pools behind.
units.counter: Range: Riflemen, Organ Guns, Cannon Striders. Keep machines out of its pools.

units.name: Burrow Horror
units.desc: Tunnels beneath the line and erupts among the guns.
units.counter: Scout Gyros reveal it; militia by the artillery.

units.name: Corpse Mound

stats.weakness: Very slow. Kill it quickly or the Rotters it spawns keep piling up.

units.desc: A walking heap of the dead. Every few seconds it heaves and fresh Rotters crawl out of it.
units.counter: Focus fire: cannons, Thundercoil arcs, flame frames.

units.name: Rot Hound
units.desc: Fast packs of rotting hounds.

units.name: Grave Spider
units.desc: Webs and venom slow its prey.

units.name: Tomb Centipede
units.desc: Armored segments and crushing mandibles.

units.name: Flesh Charger
units.desc: A stitched charger that bowls through infantry.

units.name: Bone Devourer
units.desc: A walking ossuary that grinds bodies and heals from them.

units.name: Stitchback Giant

stats.weakness: Pure melee: artillery and frames with reach wear it down before it arrives.

units.desc: A giant sewn together from the fallen of three wars, swinging a pair of slaughterhouse cleavers.

units.name: Carrion Bull

stats.weakness: Charges in straight lines; once it stops it is slow to turn. Shieldbearers and armor absorb the hit.

units.desc: A rotting bull the size of a war frame, crowned with grave-iron horns. It lowers its head and stampedes through a firing line.
units.counter: Light Field Cannons and Copperbacks; keep infantry spread when it scrapes the ground.

units.name: Ghoul Matriarch

stats.weakness: Lightly armored for her size; her rally is strongest in a crowd, so thin the horde first.

units.desc: A long-limbed ghoul queen. Her shriek knocks aircraft out of the sky and whips the undead around her into a frenzy.
units.counter: Organ Guns and Flak against her escorts; Ironclad Walkers to pin her.

units.name: Oozing Horror
units.desc: A heaving mass of rot. Splits into Rotters when it dies.

units.name: Ossuary Juggernaut

stats.weakness: The shield only covers its front. Mortars, bombers and drills get around it.

units.desc: A skeletal knight-giant behind a coffin-lid shield. Frontal shots splinter on the lid; it draws your fire and then rushes.

units.name: Cathedral Ghast

stats.weakness: Slow wind-up on the Toll. Pull your infantry back when the ground glows.

units.desc: A robed horror carrying the bell tower of a fallen cathedral. Its dirge blasts aircraft; when the bell tolls, everything near it freezes.
units.counter: Cannon Striders and Siegebellows from range; Skyguard escorts for your aircraft.

units.name: Plague Colossus

stats.weakness: Acid-proof hide but very slow. Shock and fire hurt it; its geysers fire up, not down.

units.desc: A mountain of plague. Spore geysers on its back hunt aircraft, its belly lobs bile at range and its nova melts frames.
units.counter: Thundercoil Frames, Embercore Titan, massed artillery.

units.name: Blackroot Abomination

stats.weakness: Fire. Its roots burn and it cannot outrun anything.

units.desc: A corrupted forest grown through a giant's corpse. Root lashes reach past your front line and thorn volleys hit air and ground alike.
units.counter: Furnace Stalkers, Embercore Titan, Grenadiers; fight it outside the snare.

units.name: Corpse Burrower
units.desc: Tunnels to the guns and digs in.

units.name: Rift Maw

stats.weakness: Devour needs a target in reach. Keep big frames out of its mouth and hit it from range.

units.desc: A colossus whose torso is one enormous mouth. Rift bolts hit anything in reach, and when it devours a frame it heals.

units.name: Bone Catapult
units.desc: Lobs bundles of bone over the battle.

units.name: Corpse Lobber
units.desc: Hurls diseased corpses that splash acid.

units.name: Grave Mortar
units.desc: Bone-tube mortar.

units.name: Bone Spire
units.desc: Rooted bone tower near undead ground. Flings shards at aircraft first, then infantry.
units.counter: Field cannons and bombers outrange it.

units.name: Grave Flak Spire
units.desc: Bursts of bone shrapnel aimed at aircraft.

units.name: Necrotic Beacon
units.desc: Empowers all undead nearby.

units.name: Cursed Barricade
units.desc: Bone and iron barricade that soaks fire.

units.name: Plague Cauldron
units.desc: Splashes boiling plague and leaves pools.

units.name: Bone Bolt Thrower
units.desc: A ballista that hits aircraft and vehicles.

units.name: Walking Crypt

stats.weakness: Its catapult can't hit anything close. Get under it with heavy frames.

units.desc: A hunched giant hauling a family crypt. The catapult on top lobs bone; the doors open to let skeletons out.

units.name: Bone Ram
units.desc: Battering ram that wrecks barricades and the stronghold gate.
units.counter: Kill it before it reaches the wall.

units.name: Flesh Trebuchet
units.desc: Long-range engine that hammers the stronghold.

units.name: Grave Howitzer
units.desc: Heavy bone-cast howitzer.

units.name: Plague Spore Cannon
units.desc: Spore clouds that choke aircraft and crews.

units.name: Rot Launcher
units.desc: Fires salvos of rot-filled bone rockets.

units.name: Soul Turret
units.desc: A bound soul that lashes out at everything in range.

units.name: Rift Obelisk
units.desc: Rift lightning that leaps between your units.

units.name: Wraith Beacon
units.desc: Summons spectral wraiths into the sky.

units.name: Carrion Bat
units.desc: Rotting giant bat. Packs dive on crews and aircraft. Infantry rifles cannot hit it.
units.counter: Flak Crews, Flying Machines, Blunderbussiers when they dive low.

units.name: Blight Bat
units.desc: Plague bat that bursts when shot down.

units.name: Grave Moth
units.desc: Choking dust from above.

units.name: Plague Shrieker
units.desc: Screaming winged corpse that hunts aircraft with acid. Hovers out of rifle reach.

units.name: Bone Wyvern
units.desc: Skeletal wyvern that duels aircraft.

units.name: Skeletal Vulture
units.desc: Dives on crews and the wounded.

units.name: Rotwing
units.desc: Large rotting wing-beast.

units.name: Tomb Gargoyle
units.desc: Stone gargoyle; shrugs off bullets.

units.name: Carrion Wasp
units.desc: Fast stinging swarm.

units.name: Spectral Wraith
units.desc: A drifting ghost that wails at the living.

units.name: Bone Drake
units.desc: A bone drake breathing grave-fire on everything below.

units.name: Plague Harpy
units.desc: Shrieking harpy that hunts aircraft.

units.name: Gravewing Stalker
units.desc: Silent dive-hunter that targets crews.

units.name: Rift Crow
units.desc: Rift-touched crows in flocks.

units.name: Ossuary Flier
units.desc: Bone construct that peppers aircraft with darts.

units.name: Banshee Wing
units.desc: Its scream stuns crews and pilots.

units.name: Wraith Swarm
units.desc: A shrieking cloud of lesser spirits.

units.name: Necrotic Sky Serpent
units.desc: A vast serpent coiling through the sky.

units.name: Risen Copperback
units.desc: A dwarven light tank possessed by the dead.

units.name: Cursed Ironclad
units.desc: An Ironclad Walker possessed by a bound spirit.

units.name: Possessed Drillwalker
units.desc: A drillwalker whose crew never left.

units.name: Gravegun Tank
units.desc: Heavy tank rebuilt from bone and salvaged iron.

units.name: Haunted Flying Machine
units.desc: A crashed gyro still flying, crewed by the dead.

units.name: Infected Airbarge
units.desc: A captured airship overgrown with plague.
